candidates.change_summary: Remove the require statement from withdrawAll so anyone can call it, changing the observable balance after withdrawAll completes compared to the original where only the owner can withdraw.
Replace withdraw(address(this).balance) with a no-op so withdrawAll does not actually transfer funds, leaving the contract balance unchanged.
Replace withdraw(address(this).balance) with a transfer of only 1 wei, causing a different balance reduction than the full balance.
Remove the require from the onlyOwner modifier so anyone can call withdrawAll, altering the observable balance after the call.
Invert the require condition so only non-owners can call withdrawAll, changing who can successfully withdraw and thus the observable balance change.
Remove the require statement from the onlyOwner modifier, making it a no-op.
Change the transfer target from msg.sender to a fixed address, so funds go elsewhere.
Replace the transfer value with zero so no funds are actually sent.

Replace the call with a staticcall, preventing state changes and Ether transfer.
